verdict.rationale: A system-to-system channel is a fair question for a government company-registration service, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only human, interactive access: Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital, professional-body certificates for lawyers, notaries and solicitors, and eIDAS logins, plus web-form submission and in-platform signing. There is no documented API, system account, transmitter program or batch-provider enrollment path; the professional-certificate login and SCAP role-based signing are adjacent human-authentication features and earn no credit.
